patterns.what_worked: Enumerate-first then pick-per-job: 28 Firecrawl tools enumerated; MCP search/agent broken on this deployment, so the same self-hosted Firecrawl instance was driven via REST (/v2/search, /v2/scrape) plus SearxNG JSON. Targeted scrapes with waitFor>=6000ms rendered Wowhead guides and wago.io flavor pages that generic search could not reach. Reddit keyword-filtered scrapes yielded the Forever ecosystem wave and the rotation-helper competition.
patterns.what_was_hard: MCP firecrawl_search rejects every body (Invalid request body), firecrawl_agent rejects keys, developer_search 404s, find_tools needs an Alexandria key. wago.io pack bodies are WA import strings (feature lists unreadable); old.reddit hit a 2FA wall and reddit .json scrape failed; Forever native swing-timer setup details stayed UNCONFIRMED.
patterns.skill_gap: Decoding wago.io WA import strings (or using a live-browser interact session) would unlock pack-level feature inventories; a reddit fallback (pullpush-style API) would close comment-body gaps.
